title: Restore and Recovery Service Levels Schedule — Continuum Backup & Recovery
content:
Restores under Continuum Backup & Recovery are governed by ten tier figures: the recovery time target and whether it is guaranteed, the refund attached to a guarantee, the restore response time, whether restore labor is included, the restore labor rate and billing increment, the included test restores, the overnight recovery drive shipment fee, and how long restore points stay restorable after the plan closes.

## Recovery time

| Tier | Target recovery time for a full server restore or failover (hours) | Target guaranteed with a fee refund | Refund of the month's plan fee when a guaranteed target is missed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 72 | No | 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 48 | No | 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 24 | No | 0 percent |
| Continuum BDR | 8 | No | 0 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS | 4 | No | 0 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 1 | Yes | 25 percent |

## Restore response and labor

| Tier | Restore request to technician start (minutes) | Restore labor included | Hourly rate for restore labor not included (USD per hour) | Labor rounded up to (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 480 | No | 165 | 30 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 240 | Yes | 155 | 15 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 240 | Yes | 150 | 15 |
| Continuum BDR | 120 | Yes | 145 | 15 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 60 | Yes | 140 | 15 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 30 | Yes | 135 | 15 |

## Test restores, recovery drives and after-closing restores

| Tier | Verified test restores included per contract year | Overnight shipment of a seeded recovery drive (USD per shipment) | Restore points restorable after the plan closes (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 0 | 350 | 0 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 1 | 350 | 30 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 2 | 295 | 30 |
| Continuum BDR | 4 | 250 | 30 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 4 | 0 | 60 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 12 | 0 | 90 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Only Continuum DRaaS Premier carries a guaranteed recovery time; on every other tier the recovery time figure is a target, and the refund figure is 0 percent.
2. The hourly rate is the rate for restore labor that is not included. On Continuum Backup Basic restore labor is not included; on the other five tiers it is.
3. On Continuum Backup Basic no verified test restore is included, and no restore point remains restorable after the plan closes.
4. On Continuum DRaaS and Continuum DRaaS Premier the overnight recovery drive shipment fee is zero.
